text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—They say an Umamusume and her Trainer are a two-person team.
Supporting and encouraging one another to reach for victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer's job is to unlock an Umamusume's
full potential through daily training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got to provide the best training
and help Gold Ship seize victory...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
How 'bout we go explore some sunken underwater ruins right now?!
choice_data_list: No, today we're actually going to train...!
No, today we really need to train...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you trying to say exploring underwater ruins
isn't training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A symbol of past glory, lost beneath the waves!
You're telling me unraveling that mystery isn't a noble form of training?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, it totally isn't, but still.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So you wanna train today no matter what, huh?
Don't sweat it, I hear ya loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If I say 'ping', you say 'pong.'
If I'm the 'Wind God', you're the 'Wind God' too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're beyond needing words to understand each other at this point!
Alright, let's roll! Keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think the day would come when Gold Ship and I finally saw eye to eye...!
Alright, off to the training course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Off to the training course... we go...?
................Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOO!! Fish, fish, and fish some more!
Today's goal is a haul, a bigger haul, and an even bigger haul on top of that!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what're you standing around gawking for?!
You're helping out too, ya know?!
choice_data_list: Um... what exactly are we doing?
Um... what are we supposed to be doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what else are you gonna do
when you go out of your way to visit the water besides fish?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even my pops—the best fisherman in the village—
had to retire before he could catch the master of this river...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I, his daughter, am gonna reel that master in today!
Oooooh, burn bright, my angler soul—ッ!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With my head still spinning, I ended up casting a fishing line into the river for dozens of minutes—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Nothin's bitin'.
All I hooked was the classic ol' clump of pond scum.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaaaah!! Uwaaaagh!!
Forget this, I'm gonna keel over from boredom!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go, Trainer!
Start runnin' toward Mars!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did she finally snap from boredom
and decide to start training...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey lady!
One grilled fish set meal, extra large rice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That was a close one~
I may have taken an L fishin', but eatin' this makes us even!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second Gold Ship received her grilled fish set meal,
she devoured the whole thing in the blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, stuffed to the gills.
Gratitude to all food across the universe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you tryin' to say catchin' and eatin' fish
ain't training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A self-sufficient survival lifestyle
is an extreme battle constantly flirting with danger...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How can you not understand how much immersing yourself in nature
and sharpening your wild instincts carries over to racing?!!
choice_data_list: So you mean running on pure animal instinct!
So you mean running on pure animal instinct, right!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nah, not really connected at all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welp, now that my belly's full,
time to head over to Golshi Farm and watch the carrots grow.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Catch ya somewhere in the solar system next time!
Adios!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without getting a single bit of actual training done after being
tossed around all day, I watched Gold Ship sprint off into the distance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—They say 'a horsegirl and her trainer are bound in a three-legged race.'
We'll pool our strengths and aim for victory together... surely, eventually!
